evidence: log loss +0.0155 (95% interval +0.0027 to +0.0266). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

146 picks, ROI -0.2% (95% interval -14.2% to +11.5%), win rate 59.6% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 25% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.08 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,880 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,757; a 1% edge takes 43,920. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
25 picks, ROI -100.0% (-100.0% to -100.0%): too few picks (<30) to say anything.
